_comment: Hooks for agent CLIs that use Claude-style JSON hooks (Qwen Code ~/.qwen/settings.json, Grok Build ~/.grok/hooks/nhj.json, Codex ~/.codex/hooks.json). Each command reads the hook's JSON from stdin, prints nothing and exits 0. Omit the _comment key if the CLI rejects unknown keys. See docs/other-clis.md for per-CLI differences (event names, timeouts, trust).
